messages:
Ethan Moore: Heads-up: I hit a weird production edge where streaming responses from the hosted API caused the SPA to throw when the user navigated away mid-stream. Error was `Unexpected end of JSON input` in our app.

Zara Khan: is this the same UTF-8 split problem we've seen? Multi-byte char split + using non-streaming TextDecoder?

Ethan Moore: part of it. The app code was decoding chunk-by-chunk (`decoder.decode(chunk)`) and attempting JSON.parse per chunk. When navigation aborted the fetch, the browser delivered a final partial chunk and we tried to parse it.

Ben Li: two failure modes to cover: 1) multi-byte sequences split across chunks (emoji/CJK) 2) mid-stream HTML error from auth proxy (e.g., 401 page) being parsed as JSON.

Zara Khan: proposed immediate fixes: update sample app and browser SDK to use streaming decode: `decoder.decode(chunk, {stream:true})`, buffer bytes and split on the SSE/event delimiter (`\n\n`). Only JSON.parse complete frames.

Ethan Moore: also important: when fetch is aborted or connection closed mid-event, SDK should emit a `stream_incomplete` diag event with leftover bytes (base64) and a distinct error class (StreamAbortError) so apps can log/debug instead of crashing.

Ben Li: add SDK contract: do NOT auto-retry streaming if any non-empty payload was emitted. Add opt-in `resumeFrom(token)` and server-side resume window. Default `autoRetryStreaming: 'none'`.

Zara Khan: docs: quick snippet for SPA cleanup on navigation using onpopstate + AbortController and a small test in sample-apps showing multi-byte split reproducible.

devex-bot: Created ticket INF-2190 "browser-streaming: partial-chunk parse crashes + resume policy" and assigned Ethan, Zara, Ben.

Ethan Moore: I'll open a tiny PR to change the sample app today and attach a minimal repro. If anyone hits this before fix: workaround is streaming TextDecoder + wait for delimiter before parsing.

Ben Li: I'll spec SDK events for `stream_incomplete` and `stream_status` (final status + headers) and add unit tests for partial utf8, html-injection, and abort cases. ETA end of week.

Zara Khan: perfect. I'll add the onboarding blurb and a changelog entry about streaming non-retry default. :thumbsup:
